name: vault.jobs.orders.wait
description: Waits for a readable work order to start or finish, parking a code run or reporting immediately whether the milestone has been reached.

host.description: Waits on one work order you may read until its first started attempt (until started) or its end (the default). A code-mode run parks and resumes with the view; any other caller is answered at once, and reached says if it is there.
